description: NaMnP₂NO₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.56 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.63 Å. N is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The N-O bond length is 1.19 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mn and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.41 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one N and one O atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mn and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mn and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mn and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
